The organisation shall be known as the Sunway University Student Council,
abbreviated SUSC. Its purpose is to represent the student body, organise
extracurricular events, and support member welfare across the academic year.

Membership is open to all enrolled students. Ordinary members may attend events
and vote in the annual general meeting. Committee members are appointed through
the Executive Member Recruitment process and hold additional responsibilities.

The committee is led by the President, who serves a term of one academic year
and may be re-elected once. The President is supported by the Vice President,
the Director of Human Resources, the Director of Extracurricular, and the
Treasurer.

The Director of Extracurricular oversees all club activities and is responsible
for event logistics, including venue booking and equipment. The Treasurer is
responsible for the budget and for approving reimbursement claims.

A general meeting requires a quorum of fifty percent of committee members plus
one. Decisions are made by simple majority of those present, except amendments
to this constitution.

This constitution may be amended only by a two-thirds majority vote of the full
committee at a meeting where quorum is met. Proposed amendments must be
circulated to all committee members at least seven days before the vote.

EMR stands for Executive Member Recruitment. It is the annual process by which
SUSC selects new committee members. EMR runs at the start of the first semester
and is open to all ordinary members in good standing.

After applications close, candidates are shortlisted before interviews. The
shortlisting process is chaired by the Director of Human Resources, who
convenes a panel of at least three committee members. Shortlisting is based on
the written application, prior involvement in SUSC events, and availability for
the full term.

Shortlisted candidates are notified by email within five working days of the
panel's decision.

If a committee position is vacated mid-semester, an emergency EMR may be
convened. Emergency recruitment follows the same shortlisting rules but may be
completed within two weeks. The President must approve any emergency EMR before
it begins.

Every SUSC event begins with a written proposal. The proposal must be submitted
to the Director of Extracurricular at least fourteen days before the event date.
It must include the objective, budget estimate, venue, and expected attendance.
Proposals submitted late may be rejected if resources cannot be arranged in time.

A minimum of three committee members must be present to run an event booth at
any time during opening hours. Each booth must display the SUSC banner and a
printed copy of the event schedule. Cash handling at booths is the
responsibility of the Treasurer or a delegate approved in writing by the
Treasurer.

Reimbursement claims for event expenses must be submitted within thirty days of
the event, with original receipts attached. Claims without receipts will not be
processed. The Treasurer reviews all claims and approves payment within fourteen
working days of a valid submission.

SUSC orientation is held during the first week of each semester. It introduces
new students to the council, its events, and the membership sign-up process.
Orientation sessions are run by the Director of Extracurricular together with
volunteers recruited through EMR.

Venue bookings for all SUSC events are arranged by the Director of
Extracurricular through the university's facilities office. Equipment such as
sound systems, projectors, and tables must be reserved at least five working
days in advance. Any equipment damaged during an event must be reported to the
Director of Extracurricular within twenty-four hours.
